answer: Admission runs through BoardCheck, a verifier that resolves an occupational license against the state register and a proctor-keyed education ledger, refusing any license or proctor bound to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate license or CE record from a proctor who certified over five seats in a month, burning both bonds. At three hundred dollars and forty hours per license, N fakes cost N times three hundred dollars plus N times forty hours. No spiral of cloud accounts shortens it, a falcon on the fence spots two seats behind one proctor, and no sable pelt hides a lapsed renewal.
